diagnosis: Suspected diaphragmatic injury following blunt chest trauma.
notes: Contrast study shows the nasogastric tube coiling within the left hemithorax, confirming a ruptured left hemidiaphragm.
description: Contrast X-ray for suspected diaphragmatic injury.

diagnosis: Suspected urethral injury after pelvic fracture.
notes: Retrograde urethrogram shows extravasation of contrast at the level of the bulbar urethra.
description: Retrograde urethrogram for suspected urethral injury.

diagnosis: Suspected traumatic bowel injury after penetrating abdominal wound.
notes: Contrast study of the small bowel shows a focal leak of contrast into the peritoneal cavity.
description: Contrast study for suspected traumatic bowel injury.

diagnosis: Suspected fracture of the right tibia and fibula after a road traffic accident.
notes: Local X-ray of the injured limb shows a comminuted fracture of the mid-shaft tibia and fibula.
description: Local limb X-ray for suspected tibial/fibular fracture.

diagnosis: Suspected shoulder dislocation after a fall.
notes: Local X-ray of the injured limb shows anterior dislocation of the glenohumeral joint.
description: Local limb X-ray for suspected shoulder dislocation.

diagnosis: Post-reduction check of a distal radius fracture.
notes: Local X-ray of the injured limb shows satisfactory alignment after closed reduction, with no residual displacement.
description: Post-reduction local limb X-ray.

diagnosis: Blunt abdominal trauma after a road traffic accident.
notes: Plain X-ray abdomen shows an obliterated psoas shadow on the left side with no obvious free gas.
description: Plain X-ray abdomen for blunt abdominal trauma.

diagnosis: Suspected hollow viscus perforation after penetrating trauma.
notes: Plain X-ray abdomen (erect) shows free gas under the right dome of the diaphragm.
description: Plain X-ray abdomen for suspected perforation.

diagnosis: Post-traumatic intestinal obstruction.
notes: Plain X-ray abdomen shows multiple dilated bowel loops with air-fluid levels on the erect film.
description: Plain X-ray abdomen for post-traumatic obstruction.

diagnosis: Blunt abdominal trauma, FAST assessment.
notes: FAST scan shows free fluid in the hepatorenal pouch (Morison’s pouch), suggestive of intra-abdominal hemorrhage.
description: FAST scan for blunt abdominal trauma.

diagnosis: Suspected splenic injury after a fall from height.
notes: CT scan of the abdomen shows a grade III splenic laceration with a moderate perisplenic hematoma.
description: CT scan for suspected splenic injury.

diagnosis: Head injury following a road traffic accident.
notes: CT scan of the head shows a small right frontal extradural hematoma with no significant midline shift.
description: CT scan of the head for head injury.

diagnosis: Chest trauma after a road traffic accident.
notes: X-ray chest A/P shows fractures of the 5th and 6th ribs on the right side with no obvious pneumothorax.
description: X-ray chest A/P for chest trauma.

diagnosis: Suspected pneumothorax after blunt chest injury.
notes: X-ray chest A/P shows a visible visceral pleural line with absent lung markings in the left upper zone, consistent with pneumothorax.
description: X-ray chest A/P for suspected pneumothorax.

diagnosis: Suspected hemothorax after penetrating chest trauma.
notes: X-ray chest A/P shows blunting of the right costophrenic angle with a homogeneous opacity at the right lung base.
description: X-ray chest A/P for suspected hemothorax.

diagnosis: Pelvic trauma after a road traffic accident.
notes: X-ray pelvis shows a fracture of the right superior and inferior pubic rami.
description: X-ray pelvis for pelvic trauma.

diagnosis: Suspected pelvic fracture in a polytrauma patient.
notes: X-ray pelvis shows disruption of the right sacroiliac joint with widening of the pubic symphysis, consistent with an open-book pelvic injury.
description: X-ray pelvis for suspected fracture in polytrauma.

diagnosis: Suspected acetabular fracture after a fall from height.
notes: X-ray pelvis shows a fracture line extending through the posterior wall of the right acetabulum.
description: X-ray pelvis for suspected acetabular fracture.

diagnosis: Severe head injury with airway compromise after a road traffic accident.
notes: Airway secured with rapid-sequence endotracheal intubation; correct tube placement confirmed by chest auscultation and capnography.
description: Advanced airway management for severe head injury.

diagnosis: Polytrauma with airway obstruction from blood and secretions.
notes: Airway cleared by suction and jaw thrust, followed by insertion of an oropharyngeal airway with high-flow oxygen.
description: Basic airway management for polytrauma.

diagnosis: Maxillofacial trauma with airway compromise.
notes: Airway secured with a supraglottic airway device as a bridge, followed by controlled endotracheal intubation.
description: Advanced airway management for maxillofacial trauma.

diagnosis: Suspected cervical spine injury after a fall from height.
notes: A rigid cervical collar of appropriate size applied with manual in-line stabilization maintained throughout.
description: Cervical collar application for suspected C-spine injury.

diagnosis: Road traffic accident with neck pain and suspected cervical spine injury.
notes: Rigid cervical collar applied at the scene assessment, with head blocks and straps added for full immobilization.
description: Cervical collar application after road traffic accident.

diagnosis: Suspected cervical spine injury in an unconscious polytrauma patient.
notes: Cervical collar applied by a two-person technique while maintaining manual in-line cervical stabilization.
description: Cervical collar application in unconscious polytrauma patient.

diagnosis: Traumatic amputation of the left forearm with massive hemorrhage.
notes: A windlass tourniquet applied proximal to the amputation site, controlling hemorrhage; time of application recorded.
description: Tourniquet application for traumatic limb amputation.

diagnosis: Severe laceration of the right thigh with uncontrolled bleeding after a machinery accident.
notes: Tourniquet applied above the wound with adequate pressure to control arterial bleeding; limb re-checked for distal pulse absence.
description: Tourniquet application for severe limb laceration.

diagnosis: Traumatic partial amputation of the lower leg with massive hemorrhage.
notes: Tourniquet applied at the scene and time-tagged, with hemorrhage successfully controlled prior to transfer.
description: Tourniquet application for traumatic partial limb amputation.

diagnosis: Closed fracture of the right femoral shaft after a road traffic accident.
notes: Traction splint applied to the injured limb with gentle longitudinal traction, improving limb alignment and pain.
description: Traction splint application for closed femoral shaft fracture.

diagnosis: Suspected femoral shaft fracture in a polytrauma patient.
notes: Traction splint applied with careful padding of bony prominences and distal neurovascular status confirmed intact.
description: Traction splint application for suspected femoral shaft fracture.

diagnosis: Closed fracture of the left femoral shaft after a fall from height.
notes: Traction splint applied under adequate analgesia with continuous monitoring of distal circulation.
description: Traction splint application for closed femoral shaft fracture.

diagnosis: Hypovolemic shock from blunt trauma requiring central venous access.
notes: Central venous catheter inserted via the right internal jugular vein under ultrasound guidance for rapid volume resuscitation.
description: Central venous catheterization for hypovolemic shock.

diagnosis: Traumatic hemothorax after blunt chest injury.
notes: Chest tube inserted in the 5th intercostal space, mid-axillary line, with immediate drainage of blood and re-expansion of the lung confirmed.
description: Chest tube insertion for traumatic hemothorax.

diagnosis: Suspected intra-abdominal injury in a hemodynamically stable blunt trauma patient.
notes: Diagnostic laparoscopy performed, revealing a small serosal tear of the jejunum with minimal hemoperitoneum, repaired laparoscopically.
description: Diagnostic laparoscopy for blunt abdominal trauma.

diagnosis: Diagnostic laparoscopy for penetrating abdominal trauma with a tangential wound.
notes: Laparoscopy performed to assess peritoneal breach; no significant visceral injury identified and the wound tract explored.
description: Diagnostic laparoscopy for penetrating abdominal trauma.

diagnosis: Suspected intra-abdominal injury after a stable blunt trauma with equivocal imaging.
notes: Laparoscopy performed and confirmed a small subcapsular liver hematoma with no active bleeding, managed conservatively.
description: Diagnostic laparoscopy for equivocal blunt abdominal trauma.

diagnosis: Penetrating abdominal trauma with generalized peritonitis.
notes: Emergency laparotomy performed through a midline incision, revealing a perforated small bowel loop which was resected and anastomosed.
description: Emergency laparotomy for penetrating abdominal trauma.

diagnosis: Blunt abdominal trauma with hemoperitoneum after a road traffic accident.
notes: Laparotomy performed revealing active bleeding from a mesenteric vessel, controlled by ligation with evacuation of hemoperitoneum.
description: Laparotomy for blunt abdominal trauma with hemoperitoneum.

diagnosis: Ruptured viscus following blunt abdominal injury.
notes: Laparotomy performed showing a ruptured segment of ileum with fecal contamination, resected with a diverting ileostomy fashioned.
description: Laparotomy for ruptured viscus.

diagnosis: Cardiac tamponade from penetrating chest trauma.
notes: Emergency pericardiocentesis performed via the subxiphoid approach, aspirating blood from the pericardial sac with immediate hemodynamic improvement.
description: Pericardiocentesis for traumatic cardiac tamponade.

diagnosis: Traumatic colonic perforation requiring fecal diversion.
notes: A defunctioning loop colostomy fashioned in the left iliac fossa following primary repair of the colonic injury.
description: Stoma creation for traumatic colonic perforation.

diagnosis: Prolonged airway compromise from severe maxillofacial trauma.
notes: Elective tracheostomy performed through a horizontal neck incision at the second and third tracheal rings for definitive airway control.
description: Tracheostomy for prolonged airway compromise.

diagnosis: Contaminated traumatic wound of the left leg after a road traffic accident.
notes: Wound debridement performed, excising devitalized tissue and foreign debris, followed by copious saline lavage.
description: Wound debridement for contaminated traumatic wound.

diagnosis: Road-traffic-accident wound of the forearm with devitalized tissue.
notes: Thorough surgical debridement performed removing necrotic muscle and skin, with the wound left open for delayed closure.
description: Wound debridement for road-traffic-accident wound.

diagnosis: Compound fracture wound of the tibia with gross contamination.
notes: Wound debridement performed in theatre with pulsed lavage irrigation and removal of all non-viable tissue before fracture stabilization.
description: Wound debridement for compound fracture wound.

diagnosis: Deep traumatic laceration of the scalp with active bleeding.
notes: Wound packed with sterile gauze under firm pressure, achieving hemostasis prior to definitive closure.
description: Wound packing for deep traumatic laceration.

diagnosis: Penetrating wound of the buttock requiring packing for hemostasis.
notes: Deep wound packed layer by layer with ribbon gauze to control ongoing venous oozing, with the pack secured and documented.
description: Wound packing for penetrating wound hemostasis.

diagnosis: Deep traumatic laceration of the groin with active bleeding after a fall onto sharp metal.
notes: Wound packing performed with continuous gauze under direct pressure, controlling brisk bleeding until definitive surgical repair.
description: Wound packing for deep traumatic laceration with active bleeding.
